## The "Date" columns next

```{r}

library(lubridate)

# Breakpoint for restarts
bnb <- airbnb2

date_cols <- c("first_review", "last_review", "host_since", "calendar_last_scraped", "Date") 

# Process, create numeric features, and drop original raw dimensions
for (col in date_cols) {
  new_num_name <- paste0(col, "_num")
  
  # Convert calendar timestamps to continuous day counts since Unix epoch
  bnb[[new_num_name]] <- as.numeric(ymd(bnb[[col]]))
  
  # Delete original text timestamp fields
  bnb[[col]] <- NULL
}
```

```{r}

# Split data (70/30)

set.seed(1852) 
train_idx  <- sample(1:nrow(bnb), 0.7 * nrow(bnb))
train_data <- bnb[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- bnb[-train_idx, ]

# Filter zero/near-zero variance predictors across the partitions
remove_tcols <- nearZeroVar(train_data, names = TRUE)

train_data <- train_data[, setdiff(names(train_data), remove_tcols)]
test_data  <- test_data[, setdiff(names(test_data), remove_tcols)]

# Impute evaluation attributes with median metrics calculated strictly on training observations
for (col in score_cols) {
  train_median <- median(train_data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  train_data[[col]][is.na(train_data[[col]])] <- train_median
  test_data[[col]][is.na(test_data[[col]])] <- train_median
}
```

### majority class is 0

```{r}

sum(train_data$host_is_superhost) / length(train_data$host_is_superhost)

test_data$host_is_superhost[is.na(test_data$host_is_superhost)]   <- 0

test_data$host_acceptance_rate  <- test_data$host_acceptance_rate / 100

# Set negative flags for tree architectures to safely isolate missing metrics natively
train_data$host_acceptance_rate[is.na(train_data$host_acceptance_rate)] <- -1
test_data$host_acceptance_rate[is.na(test_data$host_acceptance_rate)]   <- -1
```

```{r}
# Compute contrast dummy rules dropping primary reference fields (FullRank = TRUE)
encoder_rules <- dummyVars(formula = ~ room_type, data = train_data, fullRank = TRUE)

test_encoded  <- as.data.frame(predict(encoder_rules, newdata = test_data))

# Re-run full-rank contrast definitions across regional geographical attributes

train_city_encoded <- as.data.frame(predict(city_encoder, newdata = train_data))
test_city_encoded  <- as.data.frame(predict(city_encoder, newdata = test_data))

train_data <- cbind(train_data, train_city_encoded)
test_data  <- cbind(test_data, test_city_encoded)

test_data$City  <- NULL
```

## One-hot encoding on the amenities column. 
```{r}

library(stringr)

target_amenities <- c(
  "smoke alarm", "toaster", "mini fridge", "hot water", 
  "dishwasher", "Air conditioning", "Kitchen", "wifi", " Refrigerator", "Hot water", "Microwave "
)

engineer_amenities <- function(df) {
  df$amenities_clean <- tolower(df$amenities)
  df$amenities_clean <- str_replace_all(df$amenities_clean, pattern = c("\\[" = "", "\\]" = "", "\\\\" = "", "\"" = ""))
  
  for (amenity in target_amenities) {
    col_name <- paste0("has_", gsub(" ", "_", amenity))
    df[[col_name]] <- ifelse(str_detect(df$amenities_clean, fixed(amenity)), 1, 0)
  }
  
  df$amenities       <- NULL
  df$amenities_clean <- NULL
  return(df)
}

train_data <- engineer_amenities(train_data)
test_data  <- engineer_amenities(test_data)

```





```{r}

# Process categorical continuous communication channels
encode_response_time <- function(column) {
  char_col <- trimws(as.character(column))
  encoded  <- rep(0, length(char_col))
  
  encoded[char_col == "within an hour"]        <- 4
  encoded[char_col == "within a few hours"]    <- 3
  encoded[char_col == "within a day"]          <- 2
  encoded[char_col == "a few days or more"]    <- 1
  
  encoded[char_col %in% c("N/A", "unknown", "blank", "")] <- 0
  encoded[is.na(char_col)]                                 <- 0 
  return(as.integer(encoded))
}

train_data$host_response_time_num <- encode_response_time(train_data$host_response_time)
test_data$host_response_time_num  <- encode_response_time(test_data$host_response_time)

train_data$host_response_time <- NULL
test_data$host_response_time  <- NULL



```


### The bathroom_text must be converted to numeric
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

num_bathrooms <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      bath_temp = tolower(trimws(bathrooms_text)),
      bath_temp = case_when(
        grepl("half-bath", bath_temp) ~ "0.5",
        bath_temp == "shared baths"   ~ "0",
        TRUE                          ~ bath_temp
      ),
      bathrooms_numeric = parse_number(bath_temp)
    ) %>%
    select(-bath_temp, -bathrooms_text)
}

train_cleaned <- num_bathrooms(train_data)
test_cleaned  <- num_bathrooms(test_data)


```



```{r}

# Evacuate standard incomplete rows
train_cleaned <- na.omit(train_cleaned)
test_cleaned  <- na.omit(test_cleaned) 

# Convert the pricing distributions to log scales
train_cleaned$logprice <- log(train_cleaned$price)
test_cleaned$logprice  <- log(test_cleaned$price)

# Compute absolute IQR metrics using the training baseline subset
iqr <- IQR(train_cleaned$logprice)
Q   <- quantile(train_cleaned$logprice, probs = c(.25, .75), na.rm = FALSE)
U   <- Q[2] + 1.5 * iqr
D   <- Q[1] - 1.5 * iqr

# Using log scale to trim the data.
train_data1 <- subset(train_cleaned, logprice > D & logprice < 8)
test_data1  <- subset(test_cleaned, logprice > D & logprice < 8)

#head(train_data1)
```

```{r}
   select(-id, -neighbourhood_cleansed, -property_type,
          -latitude, -longitude,-host_city, -logprice)
```

## 1. Grid search on the ranger fit random forest.


```{r}

library(ranger)


set.seed(1852) 
sub_sample_size <- min(5000, nrow(train_final))


train_sub <- train_final[sample(1:nrow(train_final), sub_sample_size),]

# Define a light grid
hyper_grid <- expand.grid(
  mtry          = c(2, 4, 8, 22), 
  min.node.size = c(5, 10, 20),
  oob_rmse      = 0            
)


for(i in 1:nrow(hyper_grid)) {
  
  model <- ranger(
    dependent.variable.name = "price", 
    data            = train_sub, 
    num.trees       = 150,               
    mtry            = hyper_grid$mtry[i],
    min.node.size   = hyper_grid$min.node.size[i],
    max.depth       = 12,                
    save.memory     = TRUE,              
    num.threads     = 2,                 
    seed            = 1893
  )
  
  hyper_grid$oob_rmse[i] <- sqrt(model$prediction.error)
  
  rm(model)
  gc() 
}

print(hyper_grid)



```


## Chosen RF model from the above grid search has mtry of 8 and min.node.size of 5, this is to avoid overfitting

```{r}



set.seed(1852)

rf1 <- ranger(
  dependent.variable.name = "price",     
  data                    = train_final, 
  num.trees               = 100,            
  importance              = "permutation",
  mtry                    = 8,
  min.node.size           = 5,
  save.memory             = TRUE          
)

print(rf1)



```

## Drop useless variables that scored 0 or negative in your importance test
```{r}

rf_importance <- importance(rf1)
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature    = names(rf_importance),
  Importance = as.numeric(rf_importance)
)



# Sort features descending by predictive value
importance_df   <- importance_df[order(-importance_df$Importance), ]
sorted_features <- importance_df$Feature



importance_threshold <- 1000

# Automatically identify features below or equal to the threshold
useless_features_auto <- importance_df$Feature[importance_df$Importance <= importance_threshold]

# Print out the automatically caught features for transparency
cat("--- Automatically Dropping", length(useless_features_auto), "Useless Features ---\n")
print(useless_features_auto)



keep_features <- setdiff(names(train_final), useless_features_auto)

train_final <- train_final[, keep_features]
test_final  <- test_final[, keep_features]


# Verification Check
cat("\nRemaining column count in training set:", ncol(train_final), "\n")
head(train_final)

```

## 2. Spatial conversion

```{r}

library(sf)       
library(gstat)    
library(ggplot2)  

# Convert flat data to spatial coordinates using standard WGS84
spatial_train_geo <- st_as_sf(train_data1, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
spatial_test_geo  <- st_as_sf(test_data1, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

# NAD83: 3310 ( crs for California) covers the whole state 
spatial_train_projected <- st_transform(spatial_train_geo, crs = 3310)
spatial_test_projected  <- st_transform(spatial_test_geo, crs = 3310)

# Jitter coordinate duplicates to avoid spatial distance errors (0-meter distance bugs)
spatial_train <- st_jitter(spatial_train_projected, amount = 1.0)
spatial_test  <- st_jitter(spatial_test_projected, amount = 1.0)


# Check training residuals
any(is.na(spatial_train$rf_residuals))

# Missing value check
any(is.na(spatial_test$price))
any(is.na(spatial_test$rf_residuals))


```

## 1. VARIOGRAM computation and stable fitting of the kriging model on residuals 

```{r}

sub_sample_size <- min(5000, nrow(spatial_train))
spatial_train_sub <- spatial_train[sample(1:nrow(spatial_train), sub_sample_size), ]

# Compute empirical variogram
emp_vgm <- variogram(rf_residuals ~ 1, data = spatial_train_sub)

# Find total sample variance
init_variance <- var(spatial_train_sub$rf_residuals, na.rm = TRUE)

# Distributed variance stably between psill (70%) and nugget (30%) 

init_vgm <- vgm(
  psill  = init_variance * 0.7, 
  model  = "Sph", 
  range  = 5000, 
  nugget = init_variance * 0.3
)

# automated curve fitting
fitted_vgm <- fit.variogram(emp_vgm, model = init_vgm)


print(fitted_vgm)


# 2.Variogram plot
pdf("RF_residual.pdf", width = 6, height = 5 )
plot(
  emp_vgm, 
  model = fitted_vgm, 
  main  = list(label = "Fitted Semivariogram Model of Price RF Residuals", cex = 1.2),
  xlab  = "Distance (metres)", 
  ylab  = "Semivariance"
)
dev.off()

```


## 5.Test set prediction ( Local Search Neighborhood used)

```{r}



test_rf_pred <- predict(rf2, data = test_final)$predictions

# Store the baseline prediction
test_data1$rf_pred <- test_rf_pred

# Verification checks
any(is.na(test_rf_pred))
summary(test_rf_pred)


# nmax = 50 keeps the matrix processing light
test_res_kriged <- krige(
  formula   = rf_residuals ~ 1, 
  locations = spatial_train, 
  newdata   = spatial_test, 
  model     = fitted_vgm,
  nmax      = 50
)


# Extracting the interpolated residuals
kriged_residual_values <- test_res_kriged$var1.pred

# set spatial correction to 0 for unkriged points
kriged_residual_values[is.na(kriged_residual_values)] <- 0

# Combined predictions
spatial_test$final_kriged_pred <- test_rf_pred + kriged_residual_values



# Checks for data gaps 

cat("Number of skipped test points remaining:", sum(is.na(spatial_test$final_kriged_pred)), "\n")

any(is.na(test_res_kriged$var1.pred))

head(test_res_kriged)


```

# More evaluations


```{r}

evaluate <- function(pred, obs, model_title = "Actual vs Predicted") {
  
  # FIXED: Explicitly use base::mean to bypass the environment variable conflict (Aid with previous issue)
  mse <- base::mean((pred - obs)^2)
  rmse <- sqrt(mse)
  mae <- base::mean(abs(pred - obs))
  r_squared <- 1 - (sum((obs - pred)^2) / sum((obs - base::mean(obs))^2))
  
  plot(
    obs, pred, 
    main = model_title,
    xlab = "Actual Price ($)", 
    ylab = "Predicted Price ($)", 
    col  = rgb(0, 0, 1, alpha = 0.2),
    pch  = 19,
    cex  = 0.6
  )
  
 
  abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  
 
  cat("---", model_title, "Metrics ---\n")
  cat("MSE:       ", round(mse, 2), "\n")
  cat("RMSE:      ", round(rmse, 2), "\n")
  cat("MAE:       ", round(mae, 2), "\n")
  cat("R-squared: ", round(r_squared, 4), "\n\n")
}



```

### Neural Network and Hybrid framework


```{r}

library(neuralnet)
library(nnet)
library(caret)
library(janitor)
library(glmnet)
library(sf)
library(gstat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)


head(train_data1)




## Unneeded variables
train_nn <- train_data1 %>%
   select(-id, -neighbourhood_cleansed, -property_type, -host_city, -logprice)
test_nn  <- test_data1 %>%
   select(-id, -neighbourhood_cleansed, -property_type, -host_city, -logprice)


```




```{r}

tracking_cols <- c("y_pred", "rf_residuals", "rf_pred", "final_kriged_pred", 
                   "bathrooms_numeric", "has_Microwave_", "has_Hot_water", 
                   "has__Refrigerator", "has_Kitchen", "has_Air_conditioning", 
                   "has_mini_fridge", "has_toaster", "is_new_listing", "has_dishwasher")

ts_train1 <- train_nn[, setdiff(names(train_nn), tracking_cols)]
ts_test1  <- test_nn[, setdiff(names(test_nn), tracking_cols)]

# Range transformation normalisation preprocessing
preprocess_params <- preProcess(ts_train1, method = c("range"))
scaled_train <- predict(preprocess_params, ts_train1)
scaled_test <- predict(preprocess_params, ts_test1)

## Cleaning the column names
scaled_train <- clean_names(scaled_train)
scaled_test  <- clean_names(scaled_test)
 

```


## Feature selection and model selection

### Lasso Regression ( importance filter)

#### This is to select the variable subset for later

```{r}

numeric_features <- scaled_train[, sapply(scaled_train, is.numeric)]
numeric_features$price <- NULL

corr_matrix       <- cor(numeric_features, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
highly_correlated <- findCorrelation(corr_matrix, cutoff = 0.85, names = TRUE)
train_filtered    <- scaled_train[, !names(scaled_train) %in% highly_correlated]

# Run Cross-Validated Lasso importance analysis
x_matrix <- model.matrix(price ~ ., data = train_filtered)[, -1]
y_vector <- train_filtered$price
cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(x_matrix, y_vector, alpha = 1)

coef_matrix <- as.matrix(coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.min"))
coef_df     <- data.frame(Feature = rownames(coef_matrix), Importance = abs(coef_matrix[, 1]))
coef_df     <- coef_df[coef_df$Feature != "(Intercept)", ]





```

```{r}

set.seed(1852)
train_sample <- scaled_train[sample(1:nrow(scaled_train), 5000), ]



```



```{r}


set.seed(1852)
sorted_features   <- coef_df[order(-coef_df$Importance), "Feature"]
feature_counts    <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40)
validation_errors <- numeric(length(feature_counts))

for (i in seq_along(feature_counts)) {
  k                <- feature_counts[i]
  current_features <- sorted_features[1:k]
  temp_formula     <- as.formula(paste("price ~", paste(current_features, collapse = " + ")))
  hidden_neurons   <- max(3, round(k / 2))
  
  suppressWarnings({
    temp_model <- neuralnet(
      temp_formula, data = train_sample, hidden = c(hidden_neurons),
      linear.output = TRUE, stepmax = 5e5, threshold = 0.1
    )
    test_feats         <- scaled_test[, current_features, drop = FALSE]
    preds              <- as.vector(compute(temp_model, test_feats)$net.result)
    validation_errors[i] <- mean(abs(preds - scaled_test$price))
  })
}

performance_df <- data.frame(Features = feature_counts, MAE = validation_errors)
plot(performance_df$Features, performance_df$MAE, type = "b", col = "blue", pch = 16, lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Number of Top Features Used", ylab = "Prediction Error (Scaled MAE)", main = "Finding the Optimal Number of Features")



```

```{r}
r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
```

```{r}


evaluate_and_save <- function(pred, obs, model_title = "Actual vs Predicted", file_name = "diagnostic_plot.pdf") {
  mse       <- base::mean((pred - obs)^2)
  rmse      <- sqrt(mse)
  mae       <- base::mean(abs(pred - obs))
  r_squared <- 1 - (sum((obs - pred)^2) / sum((obs - base::mean(obs))^2))
  
  
  
  pdf(file_name, width = 6, height = 6)
  
  plot(obs, pred, main = model_title, xlab = "Actual Price ($)", ylab = "Predicted Price ($)", 
       col = rgb(0, 0, 1, alpha = 0.2), pch = 19, cex = 0.6)
  abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  

  dev.off()
  
  # Print scorecard metrics to the R console
  cat("---", model_title, "Metrics ---\n")
  cat("MSE:       ", round(mse, 2), "\n")
  cat("RMSE:      ", round(rmse, 2), "\n")
  cat("MAE:       ", round(mae, 2), "\n")
  cat("R-squared: ", round(r_squared, 4), "\n\n")
}

evaluate_and_save(scaled_test$n_pred, ts_test1$price, "Baseline NN", "diagnostic_baseline_nn.pdf")
evaluate_and_save(scaled_test$final_kriged_pred, ts_test1$price, "Combined NN + Kriging", "diagnostic_nn_kriging.pdf")
```

## Regression-Kriging

```{r}


library(sf)

### longitude and latitude included only in kriging model.

train_rk<-train_data1 %>%
   select(-id, -neighbourhood_cleansed, -property_type,
          -host_city, -logprice)
test_rk <- test_data1 %>%
   select(-id, -neighbourhood_cleansed, -property_type,
         -host_city, -logprice)

## Removal of past predictions.
tracking_cols <- c("y_pred", "rf_residuals", "rf_pred",
                   "final_kriged_pred", "bathrooms_numeric",
                   "has_Microwave_", 
                      "has_Hot_water", "has__Refrigerator",
                      "has_Kitchen", "has_Air_conditioning",
                       "has_mini_fridge", "has_toaster",
                      "is_new_listing","has_toaster",
                       "has_dishwasher")

# clean training and testing subsets that keep coordinates but drop tracking columns
rk_train <- train_rk[, setdiff(names(train_rk), tracking_cols)]

rk_test  <- test_rk[, setdiff(names(test_rk), tracking_cols)]

## Fixing some format issues

if("_listings_count" %in% names(rk_train)) {
  names(rk_train)[names(rk_train) == "_listings_count"] <- "listings_count"
}

if("_listings_count" %in% names(rk_test)) {
  names(rk_test)[names(rk_test) == "_listings_count"] <- "listings_count"
}



```




```{r}


library(janitor)

rk_train <- clean_names(rk_train)
rk_test <- clean_names(rk_test)

rk_train1 <- rk_train[, setdiff(names(rk_train), c("latitude", "longitude"))]
rk_test1 <- rk_test[, setdiff(names(rk_test), c("latitude", "longitude"))]

```



```{r}


library(glmnet)

set.seed(52)

sub_sample_size<- min(5000, nrow(rk_train1))
train_sample <- rk_train1[sample(1:nrow(rk_train1), sub_sample_size), ]

sum(is.na(train_sample))
# 1. Prepare inputs (Lasso requires a matrix format)
x_matrix <- as.matrix(train_sample[, setdiff(names(train_sample), "price")])
y_vector <- train_sample$price

# 2. Run cross-validated Lasso
cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(x_matrix, y_vector, alpha = 1)

# 3. Extract the features with non-zero coefficients
lasso_coefs <- coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.min")
selected_features <- rownames(lasso_coefs)[as.matrix(lasso_coefs) != 0]
selected_features <- setdiff(selected_features, "(Intercept)")

print(paste("Lasso selected", length(selected_features), "features."))
print(selected_features)


```



```{r}

library(leaps)

set.seed(42)

# 1. Split your train_sample into a 70/30 split
train_idx  <- sample(seq_len(nrow(train_sample)), size = 0.7 * nrow(train_sample))
sub_train  <- train_sample[train_idx, ]
sub_valid  <- train_sample[-train_idx, ]

# 2. Bound your max features dynamically based on what Lasso found
max_features <- min(30, length(selected_features))

# 3. Fit a forward stepwise path on the sub-training block
fit_forward <- regsubsets(
  price ~ ., 
  data = sub_train[, c("price", selected_features)], 
  nvmax = max_features, 
  method = "forward"
)

# 4. Set up an array to capture the validation errors
validation_mae <- numeric(max_features)

# 5. Calculate validation error for each feature count model
for (i in 1:max_features) {
  coef_vals <- coef(fit_forward, id = i)
  
  # Build a matrix out of the validation data
  valid_matrix <- model.matrix(price ~ ., data = sub_valid[, c("price", selected_features)])
  chosen_vars  <- names(coef_vals)
  
  # Generate predictions using matrix math
  predictions  <- valid_matrix[, chosen_vars] %*% coef_vals
  
  # Calculate MAE on validation data
  validation_mae[i] <- mean(abs(predictions - sub_valid$price))
}

# 6. Organize into a summary dataframe
performance_df <- data.frame(
  Features = 1:max_features,
  MAE = validation_mae
)


plot(performance_df$Features, performance_df$MAE, type = "b", 
     col = "darkorange", pch = 16, lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Number of Features", 
     ylab = "Validation MAE (Scaled)",
     main = "Linear Model: Validation Performance Curve")



```

### 15 features will be enough


```{r}

# 1.Names of the 15 features from  best forward selection model
best_coef_vals <- coef(fit_forward, id = min(15, max_features))
winning_features <- names(best_coef_vals)

# Remove the "(Intercept)" term so we only have the actual variable names
winning_features <- setdiff(winning_features, "(Intercept)")
print(winning_features)



rk_train1 <- rk_train1 %>%
  select(all_of(winning_features), price)
rk_test1 <- rk_test1 %>%
  select(all_of(winning_features), price)
  


# 1. Build the final formula
final_lm_formula <- as.formula(paste("price ~", paste(winning_features, collapse = " + ")))

# 2. Fit the linear model to ALL 100,000+ rows
base_lmod <- lm(final_lm_formula, data = rk_train1)

# 3. View the model coefficients and R-squared score
summary(base_lmod)

# Extract residuals (errors) from the training data
rk_train$residuals <- residuals(base_lmod)

# FIXED: Swapped out broken glmnet syntax matrix logic for a clean native LM prediction call
rk_train$y_pred <- as.numeric(predict(base_lmod, newdata = rk_train1[setdiff(names(rk_train1), "price")]))



```

```{r}

# Convert flat data to spatial coordinates using standard WGS84
spatial_train_geo <- st_as_sf(rk_train, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
spatial_test_geo  <- st_as_sf(rk_test, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

# 3310 ( crs for California) covers the whole state 
spatial_train_projected <- st_transform(spatial_train_geo, crs = 3310)
spatial_test_projected  <- st_transform(spatial_test_geo, crs = 3310)

# Jitter coordinate duplicates to avoid spatial distance errors (0-meter distance bugs)
spatial_train <- st_jitter(spatial_train_projected, amount = 1.0)
spatial_test  <- st_jitter(spatial_test_projected, amount = 1.0)

# Check training residuals
any(is.na(spatial_train$residuals))

# Missing value check
any(is.na(spatial_test$price))


```





```{r}

sub_sample_size <- min(5000, nrow(spatial_train))
spatial_train_sub <- spatial_train[sample(1:nrow(spatial_train), sub_sample_size), ]

# Compute empirical variogram
emp_vgm <- variogram(residuals ~ 1, data = spatial_train_sub)

# Find total sample variance
init_variance <- var(spatial_train_sub$residuals, na.rm = TRUE)

# Distributed variance stably between psill (70%) and nugget (30%) 
init_vgm <- vgm(
  psill  = init_variance * 0.7, 
  model  = "Sph", 
  range  = 5000, 
  nugget = init_variance * 0.3
)

# automated curve fitting
fitted_vgm <- fit.variogram(emp_vgm, model = init_vgm)
print(fitted_vgm)

# 2.Variogram plot

pdf("RK_Variogram.pdf", width=6, height = 5 )
plot(
  emp_vgm, 
  model = fitted_vgm, 
  main  = list(label = "Fitted Semivariogram Model of Regression Price Residuals", cex = 1.2),
  xlab  = "Distance (metres)", 
  ylab  = "Semivariance"
)

dev.off()


```



### LOCAL SEARCH NEIGHBOURHOOD KRIGING ON TEST SET
```{r}
 
rk_test$lm_pred <- predict(base_lmod, newdata = rk_test1[setdiff(names(rk_test1), "price") ])
actual_predictions <- rk_test$lm_pred
actual_test_prices <- rk_test$price

# Store baseline metrics in the tracking structures
rk_test$lmod_pred   <- actual_predictions
spatial_test$y_pred <- actual_predictions

# Verify calculation arrays
any(is.na(actual_predictions))
summary(actual_predictions)

# Ordinary Kriging interpolation over isolated residual targets
test_res_kriged <- krige(
  formula   = residuals ~ 1, 
  locations = spatial_train, 
  newdata   = spatial_test, 
  model     = fitted_vgm,
  nmax      = 50
)

# Extract and clean interpolated spatial correction scalars
kriged_residual_values <- test_res_kriged$var1.pred
kriged_residual_values[is.na(kriged_residual_values)] <- 0

# Combine baseline OLS predictions with spatial kriged adjustments
spatial_test$final_kriged_pred <- actual_predictions + kriged_residual_values

# Checks for data gaps
cat("Number of skipped test points remaining:", sum(is.na(spatial_test$final_kriged_pred)), "\n")
head(test_res_kriged)



```

```{r}
rk_test$final_kriged_pred <- final_test_predictions
spatial_test$final_kriged_pred <- final_test_predictions
```
